rules: Different project keys may run in parallel on the same Host.
Within one NotebookLM project, different output types may be dispatched in parallel when they do not share a conflicting resource.
At most one active task per project plus outputType key by default.
Same-project duplicate tasks of the same output type must wait until the earlier task is terminal.
A claimed task must show START/RUNNING evidence within 60 seconds or enter immediate handoff diagnosis.
Audio/video jobs are not declared stale by a fixed 10-minute rule after START; use media-duration-aware time budgets and file-progress evidence.
If tasks compete for the same dedicated Chrome tab/session, GPU renderer, download target, or output filename, serialize only that shared resource instead of the whole project.
evidenceNote: Google documents Studio as supporting multiple outputs in one notebook and multitasking, but does not explicitly document backend simultaneous generation guarantees for every output pair. This policy therefore allows cross-output parallel dispatch while verifying actual START/progress per output and serializing only observed shared-resource conflicts.
